PRE-EMPTIVE FINDING on this ticket's own file_impact — recorded as a COMMENT deliberately, because file_impact is MATERIAL and round 5's plan review is in flight; editing it now would invalidate that verdict before it could be signed. TO BE APPLIED THE MOMENT ROUND 5 RETURNS, whatever it says.

Three defects, found by running `grep -rn REBAR_LLM_MODEL` rather than trusting the enumeration:

1. TWO file_impact reasons still read "one of FIVE docs referencing REBAR_LLM_MODEL". The count was corrected to SIX in the DESCRIPTION back in round 1 (README.md:239 was the missed one), but file_impact was never updated — so the ticket now contradicts itself across fields. Fix both reasons to six.
2. The tests entry reads "deprecation precedence and ONCE-PER-PROCESS tests". Once-per-process was WITHDRAWN in round 4 as unmechanised (warn_deprecated emits unconditionally). Stale.
3. THE CONSEQUENTIAL ONE: `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py` is ABSENT from file_impact, even though round 2's finding moved the map-to-all-three fan-out INTO that file and the description now says so. The file that will hold the new code is not in the attestation's scope. That is precisely the defect that left epic 9227's attestation reading stale-head UNSCOPED. Also add README.md and the remaining docs so the six-file claim in AC5 is actually covered by scope.

ALSO VERIFIED, and worth recording because I nearly filed it as a Scope gap and it is NOT one: five files under src/ mention REBAR_LLM_MODEL — _cli/_llm_commands.py:160, _mcp_llm.py:64, llm/completion.py:72 and llm/gate_context.py:14 — but ALL FOUR are comments or docstrings. Only llm/config.py actually READS the variable. The code Scope is correct as written; no extra read site needs handling. (gate_context.py:14 mentions it only because b300's docstring explains that this very deprecation was what made config.py's headroom a blocker.)

AC5's six-file prose inventory is CONFIRMED correct by the same command: README.md, docs/config.md, docs/env-vars.md, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md. Two JSONL experiment corpora under docs/experiments/ also match but are captured run DATA, not prose to update.
